overview: Read-only server health report — no configuration required. Checks K3s, Docker, UFW firewall, and node-exporter status in one command. Useful for quick diagnostics or support tickets.

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-healthcheck

commands.description: Print system, K3s, Docker, firewall, and exporter status

notes: Read-only — does not change any configuration
Safe to run anytime for a quick status snapshot
Does not require sudo for the run command
